C.label: E_mean_lux / q
C.weights: q / mean(q of current fitting rows)

q_domain: All seven development rooms must have finite q > 0. No label-derived replacement or epsilon adjustment.
selection: Per method, GroupKFold(3) within outer fitting rooms; minimize original-lux unweighted mean validation-room MAE, exact tie takes depth3.
validation: Seven leave-one-room-out and three leave-one-orientation-out logical folds; shared posX/BM223 job reused; nine unique jobs.

gate.tie_order: Lowest primary worst-room MAE, then primary macro MAE, then A/B/C. If none passes all conditions retain trial 0.1.

scope: Only seven TRAIN rooms; no TEST numerical loading, fitting, tuning, inference or scoring. No simulations, visualization or full-seven deployment refit. Other four outputs and trial 0.1 unchanged.
stopping_rule: Only A/B/C and depths 3/5; no post-hoc scaling, extra candidates, bright-row removal or outcome-dependent prediction routing.
